Scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Temporality): 神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方：神农走了三个月，找到了有植物的地方，Both the three-month walk and the discovery are completed past events, so they need 了; 走了三个月 expresses a completed duration naturally. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 神农三个月走去：他三个月走去，he is still the only active character, so repeating the name so soon is unnecessary; use a pronoun. [rule: none]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 神农三个月走去：他三个月走去，The same character remains the subject from the previous sentence, so a pronoun is more natural than repeating the name. [rule: redundancy_delete]

output.reason: Run 1 addresses the missing aspect marker in 走了三个月, while Runs 2 and 3 instead change 神农 to 他 and leave the teacher-identified error unfixed.
